title: isodon anisochilus
intro: Isodon anisochilus, commonly known as Anisochilus carnosus or Himalayan teasel, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family, native to the Himalayan region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Isodon anisochilus include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as reducing fever and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
